2609.31181.title: Where a Model Sends Its Own Repeated Token
2609.31181.paper_summary: Black-box model identification works by scoring a model's response to natural-language prompts. One line of work feeds models a degenerate input -- their own token, repeated -- to find a failure mode rather than an identity. We take that input and ask where the model goes when it does not. For each token t, read argmax p(. | t, t) in one forward pass; the result is a map on the whole vocabulary, with two halves. The first -- which tokens are fixed points -- is partially anticipated, and we report it as a failed estimand: the natural distance on it is 83% cardinality, separates a corpus manipulation by two bits in 3471 against a precision floor of zero, and attributes families at 0.5833. The second half, where the map sends tokens that are not fixed points, is unrecorded; the one paper holding those tokens logged them as a zero. Pairing on the source token removes the cardinality confound by construction (r from 0.9128 to -0.0932) and attributes families at 0.8333 -- twelve models scored against a pool of nineteen -- with chance 0.1389, across seven tokenizer groups and several corpora. Two nulls clear it: frequency-matched destinations agree at 0.1429, independent marginals at 0.0798. Family predicts agreement better than tokenizer (0.2031 against 0.1205), and recurrent architectures cluster at balanced accuracy 1.0 against a 0.7895 majority rate, or 0.90 once each model's dominant destination is excluded -- the figure we stand behind. We measure the robustness envelope: 8-bit weight rounding moves the map less than deduplicating the training corpus does (0.9004 against 0.6353, on one support), 4-bit destroys it (0.0098; 0.1812 at deployment granularity, so not a coarseness artefact), and the precision floor varies by model from 0.201 to 0.9778. All estimands and kill conditions were registered before the data, and the failed one is reported as fully as the surviving one.
2609.31181.paper_summary_zh: 黑箱模型識別通過評分模型對自然語言提示的反應來工作。這項工作的其中一條路徑是給模型提供一個退化的輸入——它們自己的標記，重複多次——以尋找失敗模式而非身份。我們採取該輸入並詢問當模型不這樣做時它會去到哪裡。對於每個標記 t，在一次前向傳遞中讀取 argmax p(. | t, t)；結果是一個整個詞彙表的映射，分為兩個部分。第一部分——哪些標記是固定點——是部分預期的，我們將其報告為一個失敗的估計量：其自然距離為 83% 基數，將一個語料庫操作分開兩位於 3471，精度下限為零，並在 0.5833 處歸屬於家庭。第二部分，映射將非固定點的標記發送到的地方，則未被記錄；唯一一篇包含這些標記的論文將它們記錄為零。對源標記進行配對通過構造消除了基數混淆（r 從 0.9128 降至 -0.0932），並在 0.8333 處歸屬於家庭——十二個模型對比十九個池進行評分——機會為 0.1389，跨越七個分詞器組和幾個語料庫。兩個零清除了它：頻率匹配的目的地一致為 0.1429，獨立邊際為 0.0798。家庭預測一致性比分詞器更好（0.2031 對 0.1205），而循環架構在平衡準確率 1.0 下聚集，對比 0.7895 的多數率，或在排除每個模型的主導目的地後為 0.90——這是我們所支持的數字。我們測量穩健性包絡：8 位權重四捨五入對地圖的影響小於去重訓練語料庫的影響（0.9004 對 0.6353，在一個支持下），4 位則摧毀了它（0.0098；在部署粒度下為 0.1812，因此不是粗糙的工件），而精度下限因模型而異，從 0.201 到 0.9778。所有的估計量和殺死條件在數據之前都已註冊，失敗的那個報告得與生存的那個一樣全面。
2609.31181.author: Nicolás Vera Zúñiga et.al.
